text:
ethan: Heads up — after the 5.15 kernel rollout to eu-west-gpu pool, ~12 nodes lost NVIDIA modules and GPUs disappeared from kubelet. Pods hitting NCCL/init failures. Seeing DKMS build failures in boot logs.

maria: ugh. timeline? which image/driver version?

ethan: rollout started 1752499000, finished 1752500600. Hosts are Ubuntu 20.04 + nvidia-driver 510.85.02 packaged via our DKMS bundle.

jin: can you paste the DKMS error?

ethan: sure — from /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/510.85.02/build/make.log:

```
make[1]: Entering directory '/usr/src/linux-headers-5.15.0-1022-aws'
WARNING: Symbol version dump ./Module.symvers is missing; modules will have no dependencies and modversions.
make: *** [Kbuild:89: modules] Error 2
ERROR: cannot make module: failed to run make
```

alex: `Module.symvers missing` usually means a kernel headers mismatch or headers package doesn't have CONFIG_MODVERSIONS symbols. Did the kernel image and headers come from different builds?

ethan: headers installed from apt: linux-headers-5.15.0-1022-aws (same version string as vmlinuz). But dkms log also shows undefined references when insmod tried on another host: `Unknown symbol in module, err -EINVAL, : nvidia.ko: Unknown symbol nvidia_alloc_pages`

lili: That sounds like ABI mismatch between the driver and the kernel config. Could also be that our prebuilt module (we ship a prebuilt .ko) was compiled against a different symbol set.

ops-bot: [ALERT] gpu-node-euw-07 rebooted repeatedly 3x in last 15m (autoscaler flagged).

maria: Are nodes flapping because module insert fails at boot and something triggers OOM or crash? Any oops/panic logs?

ethan: dmesg excerpt from node: 

```
[    3.456789] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel.
[    3.456790] nvidia: Unknown symbol in module (required by nvidia)
[    3.456791] nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout
[    3.456792] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
```

jin: kernel panic is worrying. Could be our DKMS path didn't rebuild for some HWE variant. Quick mitigation: cordon the remaining eu-west-gpu nodes, and move scheduled jobs to dedicated fallback pool (us-central spare capacity).

alex: Agreed: cordon + evict GPU pods gracefully. Also we should stop the remainder of the 5.15 rollout. Who triggered the upgrade?

ethan: rollout triggered by eng-infra auto-rolling job (image-builder pipeline). I paused the pipeline at 1752501300 but ~30 hosts already upgraded.

sre-oncall: I'm rolling back the kernel package repo pointer for the pool so no more nodes will pick 5.15. Also creating a pinned apt preference for stable 5.4 on remaining hosts.

maria: For the impacted nodes we have two viable paths: 1) rebuild DKMS modules on-host against exact headers (slow but safe), or 2) reboot into previous kernel if available + restore pre-upgrade kernel via grub (faster if snapshot exists). Which do we have?

ethan: Some hosts still have vmlinuz-5.4 entries in grub and old initramfs cached. Reboot->select old kernel seems fastest for ~8 nodes. For the ones panicking at boot we'll need rescue from console.

lili: For long-term: we should stop shipping prebuilt .ko as the only path. Instead publish per-kernel-version module packages and/or ensure DKMS build completes in image build phase (CI). Also add a kernel-headers sanity check that verifies Module.symvers presence before rolling.

alex: Also file to track: check if this affects NCCL lib compatibility — pods logging NCCL ERROR 3: unhandled system error. Likely because GPUs invisible. Create an incident ticket so support + finance can tag cost impact (evacuations + compute spill to other regions).

ops-bot: [INCIDENT CREATED] INC-2026-145: kernel-5.15-nvidia-compatibility — assigned to eng-infra.

maria: Action plan now: 
- ethan: cordon remaining eu-west-gpu nodes and start graceful eviction (in next 5m)
- jin: prepare a prebuilt module package compiled against 5.15-1022 headers and test in staging
- lili: add Module.symvers check to image-builder CI + blockroll gate
- sre-oncall: pin apt to stop further 5.15 installs and revert repo pointer
- alex: collect kernel and dkms logs from 12 impacted hosts and attach to INC-2026-145

ethan: started cordoning and moving workloads now. evicting gpu jobs with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

jin: I'll try to reproduce in eu-west staging with the exact kernel+headers+driver and post results in thread. If rebuild works we can push a DKMS artifact back to pool and reboot nodes to pick it up.

maria: Keep updates brief in this thread, we'll do a postmortem after stabilization. Also flag customer-facing incidents for teams running heavy GPU batches in EU-WEST.

ethan: update: evictions done for 20 pods, 6 nodes still showing errors. attaching log snippets to the ticket.

lili: I'll follow up on CI change; low-risk patch and gate should land in 30m.

sre-oncall: Rolling plan approved: rollback where possible, rebuild otherwise. Standby for console access requests.

ethan: thanks all — will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
